scope: Research catalog only. Not an installed AOK schema, executable workflow, selectable methodology, or runtime capability. Work-item lists are suggestions; overlay-specific types require compatible methodology selection.

approaches.title: Direct execution
approaches.constraint: Avoid extra planning artifacts unless uncertainty emerges.

approaches.title: Explore plan implement
approaches.constraint: Resolve consequential unknowns before expensive implementation.

approaches.title: ExecPlan delivery
approaches.sequence: Plan → deliver increment → record evidence → update plan
approaches.constraint: Keep the plan resumable and acceptance observable.

approaches.title: Goal-driven iteration
approaches.chooseWhen: Measurable finish line with adaptive path
approaches.sequence: Act → evaluate evidence → select next action → repeat
approaches.constraint: Honor native lifecycle permissions and configured stop limits.

approaches.title: Reproduce repair verify
approaches.sequence: Failing behavior → cause → repair → regression check
approaches.constraint: Do not weaken the judge to obtain a green result.

approaches.title: Characterize transform compare
approaches.constraint: Baseline behavior can include defects; approve intentional semantic changes separately.

approaches.title: Scripted pipeline
approaches.sequence: Execute explicit steps with checked intermediate outputs
approaches.constraint: Script success must depend on real check outcomes.

approaches.title: Parallel workstreams
approaches.constraint: Separate contexts do not isolate files ports databases or external systems.

approaches.title: Generator evaluator
approaches.constraint: Calibrate the evaluator and test whether it earns its overhead.

approaches.title: Pilot and expand
approaches.chooseWhen: Repeated change across a large surface
approaches.sequence: Representative pilot → refine → bounded batches → reconcile
approaches.constraint: Pilot exceptional cases as well as easy ones.

approaches.title: Evidence-led audit
approaches.chooseWhen: Many candidate findings or uncertain claims
approaches.constraint: Insufficient evidence is an outcome; do not invent certainty.

approaches.title: Scheduled maintenance
approaches.sequence: Trigger → inspect → report or propose change
approaches.constraint: Scheduling is distinct from continuation toward an active Goal.

types.title: Repository onboarding

types.title: Execution path tracing

types.title: Skill and prompt improvement

Forward-test representative positive and negative cases

types.title: Model and effort evaluation

Analyze accepted results cost and failure patterns

tasks: Identify the assumption behind each component
Ablate one component at a time
